implications.vocabulary: 5 symbols sufficient (A,C,G,T,N); T->U for RNA. No IUPAC ambiguity codes observed in elDORS_v1 sequences.
implications.context_window: max 4096 nt; median 730 / mean 1026. A 2048-nt window covers the majority; 4096 is fully lossless.
implications.note: NucleicBERT used vocab 25 (IUPAC ambiguity chars) and maxlen 1024; elDORS already normalizes non-ACGT to N during construction.
